Hafen Gazette

New ferry line connects Landungsbruecken and Finkenwerder at night

Starting August 1st, the HADAG line 62 will run a night service every 40 minutes. The pilot project is funded until December 2027 and includes bicycle transport free of charge.

Editor's reference: FERRY-62-NIGHT.
